content: Pairing lifecycle event vocabulary (whatsmeow qrchan.go read this session as behavioral reference + Baileys connection.update): whatsmeow QR channel events: 'code' (with Timeout 60s first/20s subsequent), final 'success' (on PairSuccess), 'timeout' (QR refs exhausted or server disconnect before pairing), 'err-client-outdated' (on events.ClientOutdated), 'error', 'err-scanned-without-multidevice', 'err-unexpected-state'. ClientOutdated comes from <failure reason=405> (ConnectFailureClientOutdated=405 in types/events/events.go); logged-out reasons: 401=logged out from another device, 403=primary device logged out (LOCKED), 406=unknown logout (BANNED) -> IsLoggedOut() -> delete session data. Baileys CB:failure maps node.attrs.reason directly to disconnect statusCode (so 405 arrives as statusCode 405). Our Phase 2 ReconnectPolicy treats 405 as unknown -> bounded retry; Phase 3 must add DisconnectReason.ClientOutdated=405 -> Terminal + typed client_outdated pairing event, else a stale client reconnect-loops instead of surfacing. Our required vocabulary per CONN-01: code/success/timeout/logged_out/client_outdated (5 events; whatsmeow has no 'logged_out' QR event - ours derives from 401/403/406 connect failure during pairing).
